follow-up time: Until delivery (from first trimester up to approximately 9 months)
exposure: gestational age at the time of mean arterial pressure measurement (12 weeks)
Doppler ultrasound pulsality index of uterine artery
body mass index 25 in the beginning of pregnancy
cohort: 77 pregnant women with at least one risk factor for pre-eclampsia, examined in the first trimester (11+0 to 13+6 weeks of gestation) at the 1st Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics, Comenius University in Bratislava
finding: This study suggests that mean arterial pressure measured in the first trimester is a simple and cost-effective predictor of pre-eclampsia, although its sensitivity and specificity are moderate.
mod_finding: The study found a higher rate of cesarean section in the preeclampsia group.
